lines: Jab pyaar nahin hai to bhula kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: If you feel no love for me, why keep me in your thoughts?

lines: Khat kis liye rakkhe hain, jala kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: Why keep the letters when you could burn them?

lines: Jab pyaar nahin hai to bhula kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: If you feel no love for me, why keep me in your thoughts?

lines: Kis waaste likha hai hatheli pe mera naam?
couplets.en: Why have you written my name on your palm?

lines: Main harf-e-ghalat hoon to mita kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: If I am a letter written in error, why leave me on the page?

lines: Khat kis liye rakkhe hain, jala kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: Why keep the letters when you could burn them?

lines: Jab pyaar nahin hai to bhula kyun nahin dete?

lines: Lillah shab-o-roz ki uljhan se nikaalo.
couplets.en: For God's sake, free me from this doubt that follows me day and night.

lines: Tum mere nahin ho to bata kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: If you are no longer mine, why keep it from me?

lines: Khat kis liye rakkhe hain, jala kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: Why keep the letters when you could burn them?

lines: Jab pyaar nahin hai to bhula kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: If you feel no love for me, why keep me in your thoughts?

lines: Reh reh ke na tadpao, ai bedard masiha.
couplets.en: Spare me these fresh pangs, you heartless healer.

lines: Haathon se mujhe zehr pila kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: Why hold back the poison when you could give it to me with your own hands?

lines: Khat kis liye rakkhe hain, jala kyun nahin dete?

lines: Jab pyaar nahin hai to bhula kyun nahin dete?

lines: Yaqeen tumko nahin hai.
couplets.en: You have no faith.

lines: Jab uski wafaon pe yaqeen tumko nahin hai.
couplets.en: You have no faith in his devotion.

lines: Hasrat ko nigaahon se gira kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: Why do you still hold Hasrat in your regard?
